name: Italy

mandates.notes: Mandatory for central government from June 2014, extended to all public-sector entities by 31 March 2015. Legal basis: Legislative Decree No. 148/2018, transposing Directive 2014/55/EU.

mandates.thresholdNote: Universal since January 2024: flat-rate ('forfettario') taxpayers were originally excluded below EUR 65,000 turnover, the threshold was reduced to EUR 25,000 in July 2022, and the exclusion was fully removed as of January 2024.
mandates.notes: Legal basis: Law n. 205/2018. Non-resident businesses and certain cross-border transactions are excluded from this specific obligation.

extraFieldsBeyondEN16931: FatturaPA is Italy's own national XML schema, not CII/UBL/Peppol BIS, with its own CIUS per the Provvedimento of 18 April 2019. This project does not currently implement a FatturaPA serializer or reader (see packages/formats) — this row describes the legal requirement, not this codebase's coverage of it.
